who.value: car owner or buyer on desktop web

job.value: Browse 11.11 Autos deals and chat to claim one

arrivedFrom.value: the Cars category / Used Cars homescreen

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The '11.11 Autos Mega Deals' hero and 'Best of 11.11 (11-15 Nov)' deal cards with prices and countdowns make it a campaign page.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: Each deal card's teal 'Chat' button and the purple sale price stand out as the actions.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Chat' and the share icon are clear, but 'Ask AI Car Finder' doesn't say what it does with the deal.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Flash deal', 'Selling fast', 'Sold out today · Back at 12am' are plain.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Choosing a deal to chat about is within what the person knows.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each card stacks a header, subtitle, price, discount, 'Selling fast' and stock count — a lot repeated across cards.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Deals, scarcity and chat fit a campaign landing.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Prices and 'Chat' carry it, but every card adds 'Selling fast', '12 left!' and a header line on top.
